## Short summary
Sanjay Dharan is a Website Developer, Data Analyst, Data Engineer and Automation Specialist with 2+ years of production experience. He builds responsive websites, analytics and BI dashboards, data engineering pipelines, automation workflows, quotation systems and custom internal business tools.

## Priority commercial service
End-to-End Responsive Web Development: information architecture, responsive UI/UX, React + TypeScript development, SEO foundations, lead capture and WhatsApp flows, performance optimization, QA, deployment and ongoing production readiness.

## Live website evidence
- Flora Farming — https://www.florafarming.in/ — production microgreens, subscriptions and B2B platform.
- Uyirveda Health Care — https://uyirveda.in/ — Ayurvedic clinic, healthcare information and consultation portal.
More digital projects are in progress and may be added later.

## Enterprise experience
Sanjay has professional experience across EY GDS, Tacheon and Hyundai. Portfolio outcomes include a 15% pipeline velocity increase, 20% conversion improvement, 30% cloud query cost reduction, 40% reduction in recurring data-preparation effort and 50% reduction in audit review cycles.
